|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Gardulla The Hutt (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 7.4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p2-129-Gardulla_The_Hutt.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-gardullathehutt-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Gardulla The Hutt (V) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-p2-129-Gardulla_The_Hutt-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet (official text as of 16 December 2011): “During battle, if [Virtual Block 4] No Bargain on table, may lose 2 Force to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate any of your characters here to a site you occupy as a regular move (or vice versa). Immune to attrition < 3.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 16, 2011"; PDF dated 19 December 2011, the same file the Players Committee site offered in February 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174533/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 8). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Gardulla The Hutt (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Gardulla The Hutt (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “to any site you occupy” for “to a site you occupy”, “force” and “interrupt” in lower case, and no comma after “Once per game” (it writes the icons as “[Virtual]” and “[Immune To Sense]”, which is notation only): “During battle, if [Virtual] No Bargain on table, may lose 2 force to cancel a non-[Immune To Sense] interrupt. Once per game during your move phase, may relocate any of your characters here to any site you occupy as a regular move (or vice versa). Immune to attrition < 3.”<ref name="cl-1274_1-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
